desktop.notes:
• Online AI is switched off. Your photos never leave your computer or phone; the offline AI (subjects, sharp frames, eyes, similar shots, search) works as before.
• Phone: the app is now release-signed (not a developer build). It updates over 1.6.1 as usual - nothing to uninstall, your settings stay.
• Download links no longer contain your access key (one-time links instead). The author changed keys that may have been in old links - paste the new one in Settings -> Updates if asked.
• Security updates of the image and signature libraries (Pillow 13, cryptography 50) on Windows.
• The log file is now cullect.log.
• No update question at first start - updates are checked by default (switch off in Settings -> Updates). Fixed a crash on first start.
• Albums: two quick changes at the same moment no longer lose the second one.
